verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no mention of any data-export feature, open-format export, or account/data portability mechanism for Claude Code — no docs on exporting conversation history, session logs, or configuration in a standard format. While Claude Code works locally with files like CLAUDE.md and git repos (inherently open), there is no explicit capability described for exporting all stored data (e.g., session transcripts, usage history, enterprise policy data) and leaving the platform.
